post.caption: The tiara was secretly a necklace. On 20 November 1947, Princess Elizabeth married Philip in Westminster Abbey, wearing Queen Mary's Fringe Tiara. Garrard made it in 1919 for her grandmother, using the diamonds of a necklace Queen Victoria gave Mary in 1893. Garrard's ledger lists 633 brilliants and 271 rose diamonds. On the wedding morning, the tiara broke as it was put on, and a Garrard jeweler raced to his workroom with a police escort. It was repaired that morning. Years later, she said she never knew it was a necklace. Princess Anne wore it in 1973.
